entertainment.excerpt: Thalapathy Vijay's farewell to cinema on July 23 is reshaping Tamil release calendars, with advance booking already crossing ₹15 crore and the CBFC battle adding political intrigue.
entertainment.image_caption: Tamil superstar Vijay at a public appearance. His farewell film Jana Nayagan releases on July 23, 2026 across 8,000 screens worldwide.
entertainment.nri_angle: Vijay's farewell film is a cultural event for the Tamil diaspora worldwide, with massive advance booking in international markets across Singapore, Malaysia, the Gulf, and North America.

lifestyle-health.title: Ankita Konwar Becomes First Assamese Woman to Cross the English Channel, Learned to Swim Just Three Years Ago
lifestyle-health.excerpt: The endurance athlete and wife of fitness icon Milind Soman completed the iconic Dover-to-Calais crossing as part of an international relay team, marking the 100th anniversary of the first woman's Channel swim.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: An open-water swimmer cuts through the waves wearing a bright swim cap. Ankita Konwar completed the English Channel relay crossing on July 3, becoming the first woman from Northeast India to achieve the feat.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Konwar's journey from non-swimmer to Channel crosser in three years celebrates extraordinary Indian achievement and Northeast Indian representation on the global stage.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Why Summer Sunshine Alone Won't Fix Vitamin D Deficiency — Especially for South Asians
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A new UK study finds vitamin D levels barely improve even in summer for older adults and people with darker skin. For Indians — at home and in the diaspora — the problem runs deeper than a lack of sunlight.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Sunlight streaming through a natural setting. A new study finds that summer sunshine alone is insufficient to correct vitamin D deficiency for older adults and people with darker skin.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: South Asians face compounding risk factors for vitamin D deficiency — darker skin pigmentation, northern-latitude living and vegetarian diets — making year-round supplementation essential.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Cyclospora Parasite Outbreak Sickens Thousands Across the US With Taco Bell Lettuce Under Scrutiny
lifestyle-health.excerpt: More than 5,100 possible cases of cyclosporiasis have been reported across 30 states, with shredded iceberg lettuce from a Mexican supplier linked to infections at Taco Bell.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Fresh lettuce leaves displayed at a grocery store. Federal investigators have linked shredded iceberg lettuce from a Mexican facility to a cyclosporiasis outbreak affecting more than 5,100 people across the United States.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Directly affects Indians living in the US who eat at chain restaurants and buy produce from major grocery stores.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Kerala's Monsoon Flu Crisis: 4,405 Influenza Cases and 49 Deaths in 2026
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Kerala is grappling with a severe influenza outbreak driven by H1N1 and other strains as monsoon season intensifies, with the state recording the highest flu-related fatalities among all communicable diseases this year.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A healthcare worker prepares medical supplies at a clinic. Kerala's public health infrastructure has been mobilized across all districts to manage the influenza surge during the 2026 monsoon season.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: The outbreak poses a direct concern for the large Keralite diaspora, many of whom travel home during the monsoon season. Health experts advise travelers to India's southern states to get vaccinated before visiting and take standard respiratory precautions.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Ozempic and Cancer: Why the Promising Headlines Outpace the Science
lifestyle-health.excerpt: More than two dozen studies presented at a major oncology conference suggest GLP-1 drugs may reduce cancer risk, but researchers warn the evidence is observational and clinical trials are still needed.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A semaglutide injection pen, the active ingredient in Ozempic and Wegovy. Researchers are investigating whether GLP-1 drugs may have anti-cancer properties beyond their established metabolic benefits.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: South Asian communities face elevated diabetes and metabolic syndrome rates, making GLP-1 drug findings on cancer risk especially relevant for India and the diaspora.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: India Approves Wegovy for Fatty Liver Disease in New Milestone for GLP-1 Drugs
lifestyle-health.excerpt: India's drug regulator has cleared Novo Nordisk's semaglutide injection for treating MASH, a serious form of fatty liver disease that affects roughly two in three Indians, making it the first GLP-1 drug approved for this condition both globally and in India.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A medical professional prepares a syringe for injection. Wegovy is administered as a once-weekly subcutaneous injection using a prefilled pen device.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: South Asians are disproportionately susceptible to metabolic liver disease, and the approval gives family in India access to a treatment previously limited to Western markets.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Bengal's Chingri Malai Curry Ranks Among the World's Best Shrimp Dishes on TasteAtlas, the Only Indian Entry in the Top 50
food.excerpt: The coconut-milk prawn curry, a Bengali wedding and festival staple, has earned 11th place in TasteAtlas' global ranking of best shrimp dishes — beating out entries from Japan, Thailand, and Indonesia.
food.image_caption: Chingri Malai Curry, a Bengali prawn dish cooked in coconut milk with garam masala, earned 11th place in TasteAtlas' global ranking of the best shrimp dishes. It is the only Indian entry in the top 50.
food.nri_angle: The recognition puts Bengali diaspora food culture on the global stage, with the dish widely enjoyed among Indian communities abroad.

food.title: Mumbai's Iconic Ashok Vada Pav Earns Global Recognition on TasteAtlas' World's Most Iconic Sandwiches List
food.excerpt: The 60-year-old Dadar street stall that invented vada pav has been ranked 25th among the world's most iconic sandwiches by the global food guide, putting Mumbai's signature snack on the international map.
food.image_caption: A freshly made vada pav served on a plate. Mumbai's Ashok Vada Pav has been ranked among the world's most iconic sandwiches by global food guide TasteAtlas.
food.nri_angle: The international recognition of vada pav resonates deeply with the Mumbai diaspora and Indians abroad who grew up with the iconic street food.

food.title: Sanjeev Kapoor Takes Indian Cuisine to MasterChef Australia, Challenges Contestants to Cook With Indian Flavors
food.excerpt: India's most recognized chef appeared as a guest judge on Season 18, bringing a mystery box of Indian ingredients and praising a contestant's creative take on dal and curry.
food.image_caption: Celebrity chef Sanjeev Kapoor at a restaurant launch event. Kapoor recently appeared as a guest judge on MasterChef Australia Season 18.
food.nri_angle: Kapoor's appearance on one of the world's most prestigious cooking shows elevates the profile of Indian cuisine globally and is a point of pride for the diaspora.

food.excerpt: Chef Sujan Sarkar opens a 34-seat outpost of his acclaimed progressive Indian tasting menu restaurant, joining a surge of high-profile Indian fine dining in Manhattan.
food.image_caption: An Indian fine dining table setting. Chef Sujan Sarkar's Michelin-starred Indienne has opened a 34-seat outpost in New York's Hudson Yards neighborhood.
food.nri_angle: The expansion of Michelin-level Indian dining in America's most competitive restaurant market represents a cultural milestone for Indian Americans.

food.title: India's ₹1.5 Lakh Crore Mithai Industry Goes Global as Exports Surge 10 Percent Annually
food.excerpt: Gulab jamun is now one of the UK's most popular desserts, and Haldiram's ships to North America, Japan and Southeast Asia as demand expands beyond the diaspora.
food.image_caption: A tray of assorted Indian sweets. India's ₹1.5 lakh crore mithai and namkeen industry now exports about 10% of its production, with shipments growing over 10% annually.
food.nri_angle: NRIs can increasingly access authentic mithai during festivals as export infrastructure expands, with Haldiram's and other major manufacturers shipping to the US, Canada, Singapore, Japan and European markets.

food.title: Houston's Mahatma Gandhi District Is America's Best Indian Food Corridor
food.excerpt: From Michelin-starred fine dining to $3 jalebi at a 40-year-old sweet shop, Houston's Hillcroft corridor and beyond offer the most diverse Indian food scene in the United States.
food.image_caption: An Indian thali with curry, rice, naan, and accompaniments. Houston's Indian food scene ranges from casual thali plates to Michelin-starred tasting menus.
food.nri_angle: Houston's 300,000-strong South Asian community has built a restaurant ecosystem that serves as cultural infrastructure for celebrations, wedding functions, and everyday connection to regional flavors from across the Indian subcontinent.

food.title: New York Indian Dining Scene Reaches New Heights With Wave of Ambitious Openings
food.excerpt: From Michelin-starred tasting menus to Kerala coastal cuisine, a surge of Indian restaurants is rewriting the city's culinary map in 2026.
food.image_caption: An array of Indian dishes showcasing the diversity of flavors now available at New York City's newest restaurants. The city's Indian dining scene has expanded rapidly in 2026.
food.nri_angle: The wave of ambitious Indian restaurants in New York — from Kerala coastal cuisine to Michelin-starred tasting menus — gives the metro area's 800,000-plus Indian Americans unprecedented access to hyper-regional flavors from home.

carousel.excerpt: The Department of Homeland Security has reinstated a Trump-era policy that expands the range of public benefits weighed against green card applicants, effective September 18.
carousel.image_caption: The exterior of a U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement building with the American flag. The Trump administration issued a final rule on July 16 expanding the benefits that immigration officers can weigh when adjudicating green card applications.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian green card applicants, especially those in family-sponsored categories or with gaps in employment during their lengthy wait times, may face heightened scrutiny under the revived public charge framework.

carousel.excerpt: India's Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau has moved into the analysis phase of its inquiry into the Boeing 787 crash that killed 260 people, with a final report expected within six weeks.
carousel.image_caption: The wreckage of Air India Flight 171 at the crash site near Ahmedabad airport. India's aircraft accident investigation bureau says it has entered the final stages of its probe into the June 2025 disaster that killed 260 people.
carousel.nri_angle: The Air India crash killed passengers bound for London and has heightened safety concerns among Indian diaspora travellers.

carousel.nri_angle: Indian tech professionals at US AI companies face competitive pressure while Indian startups gain access to cheaper, powerful open-source models.

carousel.title: HDFC Bank Q1 Profit Rises 5% to ₹19,060 Crore as Provisions Plunge
carousel.excerpt: India's largest private lender posted steady earnings growth in the June quarter, broadly meeting analyst estimates, as a sharp drop in bad-loan provisions offset a decline in treasury income.
carousel.image_caption: Stock market trading screens displaying financial data. HDFC Bank reported a 5% rise in June quarter profit to ₹19,060 crore, driven by lower provisions and accelerating loan growth.
carousel.nri_angle: HDFC Bank, India's largest private lender and a widely held stock among NRI investors, posted steady quarterly growth amid leadership transition.
